# OrderViaChat

> The simplest way for small businesses to accept orders on WhatsApp. Free forever.

OrderViaChat (https://orderviachat.com) is a free platform that lets small businesses create an online store and receive customer orders directly via WhatsApp. No login required for customers, no transaction fees.

## Features
- Create a free online store with products, categories, and pricing
- Customers browse and order without downloading apps or creating accounts
- Orders are sent directly to the business owner's WhatsApp
- Customizable store branding (colors, logo, business details)
- Mobile-first responsive design
- Multi-language support

## How It Works
1. Business owner signs up and creates their store
2. Add products with images, descriptions, and prices
3. Share the store link with customers
4. Customers browse, add to cart, and checkout
5. Order details are sent as a WhatsApp message to the business

## Use Cases
- Small restaurants and cafes
- Home bakers and food businesses
- Local shops and retail stores
- Service-based businesses
- Any small business wanting to accept orders online without complex e-commerce setup
